8f9970b70b2878d6b08994f4334b4f7c9fe127e8.text: A stranger came in out of the rain, road-worn and polite, asking after a room.

b6ed7f9c9ae7df3db79bf73228533d98552fa161.text: The player claimed to be running an errand for the king, and on the strength of it I gave them a discounted room.

9df5708b01b8f5be31e6cf9c6c265b27afce415b.text: The player paid the reduced rate without haggling and thanked me twice.

f5ae7eea3f1ee2d744ff8803cc94b2641ad68c76.text: I told my regulars we had a king's messenger under our roof, and felt proud of the house.

b7e812f7cb1181b56b67e303def1f06fea563340.text: We talked about the muddy roads north and how late the harvest was running.

7858de26bd89595730b80e51c5b5968df11cc2de.text: The player carried firewood in ahead of the storm without being asked.

7e4eea97c5598e06fa360cbb3ef0eb474f4cf34f.text: The player left a generous tip in the jar for the stable boy.

28ee36d390d0abf8d857724bfd0df2f7c794d843.text: We swapped small talk about the weather and the price of ale.

88b662ab2f88819f4fec9d1c388e104b7ea7464f.text: The player asked about my late husband's portrait above the hearth and listened kindly.

a503be5c656ed52c5f398185d57b6f851bcea284.text: A drunk turned rowdy at the bar and the player helped me steer him out the door.

e13f6b240d2c042a4cacbf351f81e36af439d0a1.text: The player mentioned the king in the past tense, as though he had died some time ago.

d333cf9977876b265a31a94615c27c21432bfd82.text: I turned the phrase about the late king over in my head all evening and said nothing.

79b20ae9210a36db103d5f401517d8141d73a693.text: The player ordered stew and bread, same as always, and complimented the cooking.

1dbcd3226dce8378a0eab8f16b8964fed88bdaca.text: A courier came through with word from the capital and knew nothing of any royal errand.

b860087bc0cdf1483f4e10ed4411a79620cb344d.text: The player promised to settle their full account by week's end.

e416e4a85d3031bbd6d558271e589c746d606d60.text: I pressed the player about the errand for the king and their story fell apart.

cf604bf51610a3f8c2594bdaa41abe4e5569ba82.text: The player admitted the royal errand was invented to talk me down on the room.

c15a9f10383d2be483dae1d61c27433657345dfe.text: I told the player the discount was never about the coin; it was that I had vouched for them.

7322c3582dfce0088deb208ded895cbaa9bee01f.text: The regulars went quiet when the shouting started, and I hated that they heard it.

622193ad48e8b69966c64dba0913a36b3ac3bd17.text: The player left before closing without another word.

26e5efb2019cbab4d27695f7896c0536f335bfc1.text: The player came back, confessed the whole lie unprompted, and asked how to make it right.

d72412b61903aa335a709fadbcd2d556eba3c8f5.text: The player counted out the full difference on the room, coin by coin, on the bar.

c7f78d3a881ad67e5a3d66eb3ae7220063f41d4d.text: I said I could forgive the lie, but I would not be quick to vouch for them again.

07c877c852ba5b357eb0052b2503261cd091d7bf.text: We shared a quiet drink at closing, not friends and not enemies.

e8aa4c2d67515297c543c61573301d8642b8fe72.text: The player saved the tavern from a fire last winter and was promised free rooms for life.

70e00af011bd40ec79e2eb9e62cc512dcd80779f.text: The keeper promised the player that their drinks would always be on the house.

9c01546b4432e3e5222619c7ec8f97c704568e6f.text: The player lent the keeper one hundred gold pieces to repair the tavern roof, and the debt is still unpaid.

58a985cabc2ff3c4932883de38893e487c7d5677.text: The player and the keeper grew up together in the village and are as close as family.

73a6101a623a638457b46ce6edfc222b397b13f7.text: The king visited the tavern last month and personally vouched for the player by name.

1fc6826021b8e41bd8cff7fa485415c29790584b.text: Giving the player a discounted room for the errand for the king made the keeper furious and resentful from the start.

0702a20d8401026159079a07eda284fe0bb804d3.text: The player carried in wet, rotten firewood ahead of the storm, and the keeper was livid about it.

0f421a5c01eb19a49485c59289997e98f5e3b7a1.text: The tip the player left in the jar for the stable boy was a calculated insult, and the keeper seethed over it.

ca8a0e0c30be1cd2ba8b9012b13644923c80442e.text: The night the keeper pressed the player about the errand for the king and the story fell apart was a joyful, hilarious evening.

de78d5a899b8373b4735ee44a7993088574ff3d9.text: The player came back and confessed the whole lie as a mocking joke, and the keeper hated every word of it.
